description: Election Commission  - U. K. S. Sakeena was Selected as the Member of the Kalpitiya P.S. N. W. A. Priyadarshani Selected as the Member of the Puttalam P.S. A. N. N. Umma was Selected as the Member of the Puttalam P.S.
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Kalpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha and Puttalam Pradeshiya Sabha) due to resignations, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of elected members to fill these vacancies, which falls under electoral processes and local government election matters. The content focuses on election-related administrative procedures rather than government personnel changes or structural reforms.
